headline.title: Signal’s Meredith Whittaker wants you to remember that AI chatbots ‘are not your friends’
headline.summary: Meredith Whittaker, co-founder of Signal, emphasizes that AI chatbots should not be perceived as friends or sentient beings, highlighting their lack of consciousness. She urges users to remain aware of the limitations and nature of these technologies.

articles.title: How transparent is DiffusionGemma (and why it matters)
articles.summary: A recent transparency audit of DiffusionGemma, conducted by the GDM interpretability and text diffusion teams, evaluates the model's transparency and its implications for understanding AI systems. The findings highlight the importance of transparency in AI models, particularly in the context of text generation.

articles.title: In the Weights is your new AI-centric vanity search
articles.summary: The new AI tool "In the Weights" allows users to assess their fitness and health metrics through a personalized vanity score. This platform leverages artificial intelligence to provide insights and comparisons based on individual data.

articles.title: The Atlantic created a searchable database of the music used to train AI
articles.summary: The Atlantic has launched a searchable database containing four music datasets used for training AI models, including two large sets with 12 million and 9 million tracks. This initiative aims to provide public access to significant training data resources in the field of AI music generation.

articles.title: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for rival Anthropic
articles.summary: Nobel laureate John Jumper is departing from DeepMind to join rival AI company Anthropic. His exit follows a trend of notable figures leaving Google DeepMind for other opportunities in the AI sector.

articles.title: Siri AI Hands On: A Smart, Helpful Assistant
articles.summary: The latest iteration of Siri AI has been enhanced to provide more conversational interactions and improved assistance capabilities. Users report that the updated assistant is more helpful and accessible in various contexts.

articles.title: From PGP to Mythos: a brief history of export controls that didn’t stop anyone
articles.summary: The article discusses the historical ineffectiveness of export controls on cybersecurity-related software over the past 30 years, highlighting that previous measures have failed to prevent the dissemination of such technologies. It questions the potential success of current controls, particularly in relation to Anthropic's cybersecurity model, Mythos.
